name: cad-bench-full-reviewer-artifact
description: Full anonymous CAD-bench reviewer artifact for an executable benchmark of language-model CAD agents. It includes task payloads, reported result rows, a source archive, and provenance artifacts for the paper tables. Each task contains a natural-language prompt, TOML metadata, task-specific expected values, a reference Build123D program, and optional fixtures or Blender assets. The benchmark evaluates submitted CAD artifacts with geometric, thread, and rigid-body functional scoring.
citation: Anonymous Author(s). CAD-bench: An Executable Benchmark for Language-Model CAD Agents. 2026.

distribution.name: tasks_manifest.json
distribution.description: JSON manifest with one record per task and SHA-256 hashes for files in each task bundle.

distribution.name: task_directories
distribution.description: All per-task payload directories under tasks/<task_id>/.

distribution.name: cad-bench-reported-results.json
distribution.description: Reviewer-facing JSON artifact containing every complete 17-task row from the anonymous reviewer result payload reported by the paper, with standalone model and agent rows separated.

distribution.name: cad-bench-task-aggregates.json
distribution.description: Reviewer-facing JSON artifact containing per-task mean overall score and build success for the 19 standalone model rows and 32 agent rows reported by the paper.

distribution.name: cad-bench-scorer-validation.json
distribution.description: Reviewer-facing JSON artifact containing representative reference, valid alternative, minor-defect, major-defect, and nonbuild submissions used to calibrate CAD-bench scoring and compare full scoring against simple ablations across pose, feature, fastener, threaded-pair, and functional gearbox cases.

distribution.name: cad-bench-repeat-stats.json
distribution.description: Source-artifact JSON containing repeated-run statistical checks for seven standalone configurations, including bootstrap confidence intervals and exact paired sign-flip tests for static-versus-functional difficulty contrasts where repeat counts support them.

distribution.name: anonymous_source_archive
distribution.description: Anonymous source archive for the benchmark runtime, scoring code, harnesses, release metadata, and paper source.

distribution.name: run_provenance_artifacts
distribution.description: Approved run manifest and mirrored provenance artifacts for complete published rows.

recordSet.name: tasks
recordSet.description: One record per CAD-bench task directory. Records are enumerated by tasks_manifest.json and resolved by the CAD-bench runtime.

field.name: bundle_sha256
field.description: SHA-256 digest over the task bundle's file-hash map.

field.name: files
field.description: Per-file SHA-256 hashes within each task bundle.

rai:dataCollection: Tasks were authored as synthetic CAD prompts, benchmark metadata, reference programs, and fixtures. The dataset does not contain human-subject records, scraped personal data, or redistributed commercial CAD models.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating language-model CAD agents and CAD code-generation systems through the CAD-bench runtime. It is not intended to certify generated mechanical designs as safe for manufacturing or deployment.
rai:dataLimitation: The benchmark has 17 tasks and emphasizes Build123D-compatible reference implementations in the current release. Some tasks are already close to solved, while functional assembly tasks remain difficult. Scores should be interpreted as diagnostic signals rather than broad CAD competence guarantees.
rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark has 17 tasks and emphasizes Build123D-compatible reference implementations in the current release. Some tasks are already close to solved, while functional assembly tasks remain difficult. Scores should be interpreted as diagnostic signals rather than broad CAD competence guarantees.
rai:dataBiases: The task distribution reflects authored mechanical CAD prompts and overrepresents programmatic Build123D-style construction, metric units, and small mechanical parts relative to the full range of CAD work.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive uses include more transparent evaluation of CAD assistants, engineering education, and lower-friction prototyping. Misuse risks include overtrust in generated mechanical designs and faster iteration on unsafe or restricted hardware. The benchmark should not be used as a safety certification tool.
rai:dataSensitive: No personal or sensitive information is included in the task records.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included in the task records.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Task metadata, expected values, and reference programs were authored and reviewed as benchmark assets; no crowdsourced annotation was used.
rai:annotations: Task metadata and expected values were authored by the benchmark creator. Reference programs are benchmark-side solutions, not model training labels.
rai:dataMaintenance: Task hashes are recorded in tasks_manifest.json. Future task refreshes should be versioned with a new reviewer data mirror revision and corresponding manifest.
rai:maintenancePlan: Task hashes are recorded in tasks_manifest.json. Future task refreshes should be versioned with a new reviewer data mirror revision and corresponding manifest.
